ugrid_generation_rules: UGRID(MANHATTAN): use only segments where name=='Manhattan'.
UGRID(LAND_ALL): union segments for all landmasses (already non-overlapping).
Waterways are implicit as any cell not covered by a land segment.

notes: This file is designed so an AI can generate UGRID masks from shoreline alone.
Segments are per-row inclusive west/east bounds in metro columns.
Non-overlap is enforced; Manhattan is preserved as the primary reference coastline and other landmasses are clipped or shifted to guarantee waterways.
PATCH v1.2: Battery taper corrected by narrowing Manhattan rows 120-124 into a wedge (rows 120..124 => widths 2,4,6,8,10).
PATCH v1.2: Explicitly marked west/east bounds as inclusive to prevent off-by-one rendering.
